title: Two Validation Checks
description: Budget matching and run number collision prevention.
body: Two things ingestion checks before it writes anything, because a run file is audit evidence and PRD section 6.6 forbids losing a reference in silence. First, every budget the artifact reports must match a `budget` node under the scope it is filed against. Second, a run number already on disk is never overwritten; a stale or malformed re-ingestion must not corrupt a run that already landed.
